_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#26 — runtime VTK output is a silent no-op unless BOTH IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT (with INTERVAL_STEPS > 0; the default is -1 = never, see src/inpar/4C_inpar_IO_runtime_output.cpp) and the per-field IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/STRUCTURE sub-section are present. The fixture runs the same 2-step HEX8 deck four ways and reports EXIT and the .vtu count. All four exit 0; only the complete configuration writes files, which is exactly why this failure mode is invisible without counting output. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf).
